name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.
texts: If the agent picks up the key (has_door_key becomes true), then the door must be opened (door_open must become true at some point thereafter).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, door_open) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u0) -> 1
